backend/main.mo: Defines a Product type and initializes a Map with preset products via an initialize function.
feature_evidence.json: Describes evidence linking a header-logo update feature to SiteHeader.tsx with metadata and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Assembles the full page layout and triggers catalog bootstrap on mount.
frontend/src/components/feedback/InlineE: Displays an error message with optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders site footer with dynamic year and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Responsive header with navbar-1.png logo and smooth-scroll navigation including mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Shows product image, description, and price with hover and image-fallback behavior.
Skeleton placeholder used while product data is loading.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Static section highlighting Kleenora’s values with icon-based feature cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section with phone, email, and location details in styled cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero banner with gradient styling, headline text, and a button that scrolls to the products section.
frontend/src/components/sections/Product: Loads and displays products with loading, error, and fallback seed product states using ProductCard components.
frontend/src/data/seedProducts.ts: Provides a static list of seed Product objects used for bootstrapping or fallback display.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCatalogBootstrap.t: Provides a bootstrap routine that clears products, initializes the backend, and populates it with seed products.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and exposing login and logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, initializing, and clearing products through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining color themes, dark mode, and global typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entrypoint that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, themes, animations, and enabling plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state for building a Kleenora website, including branding, product-catalog requirements, contact updates, and known build issues. Lists existing features and constraints for applying logo, products, and theme updates.
